text:
Maria Gonzalez: quick async standup — kernel pivot work update
Maria Gonzalez: what I did: landed the minimal kernel changes to support async slot refill and a fast-path for single-stream requests. pushed a canary build to staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123 :tada:
Maria Gonzalez: blocker: seeing a ~8-12% p99 regression under microburst load when slot stealing triggers KV prefetches
Ajay Patel: noted — do we have a reproducible bench?
Maria Gonzalez: yes, ran a 10k req synthetic with 16-client microburst script. attaching tail of the log:
Maria Gonzalez: ```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z INFO batcher: alloc slot id=23
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z WARN kv: prefetch miss for model:v2, key=ctx-...
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z INFO kernel: async refill started for slot=23
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z ERROR perf: p99 increased from 98ms -> 110ms
```
Liam Chen: thanks, curious if the miss pattern aligns with eviction window. what was cache hit rate?
Maria Gonzalez: hit rate dropped from 98.7% -> 93.2% during the burst window. looks like prefetch is kicking in too late for some hot prefixes
Sophia Ng: can we change prefetch threshold to be more aggressive for single-stream fast-paths? maybe only prefetch when seq_len > 32?
Ajay Patel: we tried seq_len gating earlier and caused extra overhead for medium-length requests. alternative: add a lightweight bloom filter for hot-prefix membership to avoid unnecessary prefetch.
Liam Chen: +1 for bloom filter. cheaper than full prefetch. how big of a filter? false positive rate target ~1%?
Maria Gonzalez: thinking of a 64k-bit filter per model shard. false pos ~0.8% and fits in L2 cache for most workers. low-risk toggle behind feature flag.
Maria Gonzalez: plan for today: 1) add bloom filter fastpath (dev branch), 2) run the microburst bench with canary toggles, 3) open follow-up PR for tuning params
Ajay Patel: I'll review PR when ready. ping me in the thread or @ajay for quick review.
Sophia Ng: can you also add a probe that reports bloom hits/misses in the runtime metrics? we should graph that in console before rollout.
Maria Gonzalez: yes — I'll emit metrics: `kv_bloom_hits`, `kv_bloom_false_positives`, `kv_prefetch_skipped`
ops-bot: deploy staging canary for job kernel-pivot-2026-03-15 completed — 3/3 pods ready
ci-bot: perf-bench/async-microburst job finished — summary: median=14ms p95=72ms p99=112ms (with current canary)
Liam Chen: p99 still a bit high but looks better than before? what's baseline p99 for master?
Maria Gonzalez: baseline master p99=98ms (non-canary) so canary is slightly worse atm. hoping bloom filter reduces that.
Sophia Ng: small UX ask — add an alert if kv_prefetch_skipped > 5% for more than 2m; we had silent regressions before.
Maria Gonzalez: good call — will add that to the canary alert rules.
Ajay Patel: blockers for me: none. I'll help with the bloom implementation later today.
Liam Chen: blocker: need the compiled kernel patch for the bloom checks — pinged infra for build queue priority.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks. I'll post PR link here when ready and include a short perf run in the PR description.
Maria Gonzalez: quick question to team — any objections to rolling the bloom filter behind default=off for 24h canary in dedicated?
Ajay Patel: no objections, prefer off by default.
Sophia Ng: no objections.
Liam Chen: ok from infra side.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks all — will update thread with PR and perf runs. :rocket:
